title: Catacombs of the Forgotten
subtitle: Quest: Mi Krau-Li's Jitte, at the bottom with his Sarcophagus
steps: In the Facility Hub, talk to the Warden about Mi Krau-Li.
Take the level 25 portal to the Catacombs of the Forgotten.
Go to the bottom and take Mi Krau-Li's Jitte.
Show it to the Warden for the reward.

notes.title: Quest item
notes.body: The Jitte is placed in the data. His Sarcophagus is in the same area, and the route to it is also given.

notes.title: Best damage
notes.body: Skeletons take full bludgeon, then 0.58 slash. Cold, lightning and pierce are weak (0.25-0.4).

notes.title: Numbers
notes.body: 65 Skeleton Captains, 19 Skeleton Lords (level 40) and 3 Wraiths (level 50).
